decision_note: Robots disallow only enumerated administrative/system paths and do not match either intended path; open-data policy supports public access but does not clearly authorize automation
Robots URL redirected to Earthdata Login rather than returning robots directives; policy request returned HTTP 403; registered data access requires authentication and is blocked regardless
Robots file contains only User-agent and Sitemap with no path guidance; silence is not affirmative allowance; shared NOAA policy request returned HTTP 403 and source was stopped
DOI public-domain terms and official GET API documentation support reuse, but robots explicitly says Disallow: / for User-agent: *
Robots request returned HTTP 403; per source stop rule the policy, metadata, and calendar pages were not requested and silence cannot be upgraded to permission
Shared NOAA policy request returned HTTP 403; source-level stop prevented further robots and metadata requests; permission remains unresolved

Official policy makes datasets available without registration, license, or usage restriction and expressly covers application developers and feeds; robots has Crawl-delay and unrelated disallows but no explicit Allow for the aggregate /resource path, so silence remains unclear; DP-PW-001 was made under a superseded interpretation and is preserved
Robots explicitly disallows /api/ for User-agent: *; terms state that domain terms have not been defined; cached HTML triggered the conservative CAPTCHA marker stop, so no further request was made
